subject: Invitation to our Annual Charity Gala
body: Dear valued supporters, We are delighted to invite you to our annual charity gala event on Saturday, December 12th, at the Grand Ballroom. Join us for an evening of dinner, live music, and a silent auction to support our cause. Your attendance and contributions will help make a positive impact on the community. Please RSVP by November 30th to secure your seat. We look forward to seeing you there!
